info.title: Insurance Scraping API
info.description: Multi-tenant quote automation with per-consultant authentication

get.description:
Return all consultants with full data (admin only).

Includes sensitive fields: ecohub_password, disabled_scrapers.

200.description: List of all consultants with full data

post.description:
Create a new consultant with auto-generated API key.

EcoHub credentials are optional. If not provided, the consultant
will use the fallback (global) EcoHub account for quote generation.

Returns the generated api_key — store it securely, it cannot be retrieved later.

patch.description:
Partially update a consultant by integer ID.

Only fields present in the request body are updated.
disabled_scrapers accepts any subset of:
["axa", "Allianz", "Helvetia", "Generali", "Simpego", "Zurich", "Vaudoise", "Automate", "Mobiliar"]
or an empty list [].

get.description:
Get full consultant record by onezone_id (admin only).

Returns all fields including sensitive data: api_key, ecohub_password,
ecohub_totp_secret, disabled_scrapers.

post.description:
Update EcoHub credentials for a consultant. Evicts any active browser session
so the next request re-authenticates with the new credentials.

Verify a consultant's EcoHub credentials by attempting an actual login.

Returns the verification result:
- {"status": "already_verified", "login_check": true} — already passed
- {"status": "verified", "login_check": true} — login succeeded, flag updated
- {"status": "failed", "login_check": false, "error": "..."} — login failed
- {"status": "error", "login_check": false, "error": "..."} — missing credentials or consultant
Extract the TOTP secret from an authenticator QR code image.

example.detail: No QR code found in image

post.description:
Generate insurance quotes for a user.

Requires a valid consultant API key in the Authorization header:
    Authorization: Bearer <consultant_api_key>

The consultant's EcoHub credentials are used for scraping. If the consultant
has no EcoHub credentials, the fallback (global) account is used.

single_vehicle.description: One vehicle (`interchangeable_plate: "No"`, no Vehicle 2 fields). Runs the selected scrapers and emails a quote.

two_vehicles.description: Two vehicles sharing an interchangeable plate (`interchangeable_plate: "Si"`, Vehicle 2 block required).

registration_only.description: Registration only: `registration_scraper: "zurich"`, `registration_only: true`. Produces the eVN code, no quote PDF. Needs `submit_vehicle_proof_1: "Yes"` + `reasons_for_redemption_1`.

registration_and_quote.description: Quote **and** registration in one run: `registration_scraper: "zurich"`, `registration_only: false`. Returns the quote PDF/price plus the eVN code.

200.description: Quote request accepted and processing queued

example.message: Quote request saved and processing queued

example.detail: Session pool full. Try again later.

post.description:
Re-run scraping for an existing request ID from the database.
Useful for retrying failed requests or testing with real data.

Authenticated with the admin API key only. If `consultant_onezone_id` is provided the
run impersonates that consultant (uses their EcoHub credentials/session);
otherwise it runs as the default admin consultant. An impersonated
consultant without verified own credentials is rejected.

200.description: Test task queued by request ID

example.message: Test task queued for request 123 (Scrapers: all)

MainDriver.title: MainDriver
MainDriver.description:
Who drives the insured vehicle.
- user: the policy holder drives (no extra data needed)
- other: a different person drives -> `driver` holds their full PersonData
- multiple: several drivers

PersonData.title: PersonData
PersonData.description:
Personal data of a driver. Mirrors the Personal Info fields of UserSchema.
Used only inside MainDriver when driver_type == 'other'. All optional.
